description: Assessment appeal application page 1: numbered form sections 1-4 are headings; the mailing address, fee and pay-to lines are not; the Wingdings check box is not a letter P. The bold-caps sub-labels in section 3 are h3 under their h2 section; PROPERTY TYPE is also the legend of its check-box group. The Mail to / Fee / Pay to panel, between two thick rules, is one framed group named by its first line, before section 1 (#170). The Yes / No boxes of section 3 are one group whose legend is the question printed after them; each label holds only its own word (#281). The 11 boxes of PROPERTY TYPE, printed in three columns under its heading, are one group (#281). The text boxes of sections 1 and 2 are each a group named by the section heading (hidden legend; the heading is in view), and no fieldset has an empty legend. The Yes / No boxes are radios of one group, each still its own PDF field. The group follows its PROPERTY TYPE heading: the boxes of its second column, a point higher than the first's, don't lift it above the heading. Each text box gets its type, inputmode and autocomplete token from its label (#281): section 1's email, city, state, ZIP and area code are the applicant's own and carry a token; the same labels in section 2, the agent's, carry none; fax carries none; no box is type=date. A blank printed inside an option’s label ("OTHER: ____", "NO. OF UNITS ____") is cut from the label and the text box that sits on it follows its check box in the group, named by the option’s text (#281, F7). The fee's "$65.75" is printed in red: a red accent over those characters, inside the bold "FEE:" (#281).
